title_zh: 选定低调补片以保留纪念外套

scenario.label_zh: 修补有纪念意义的外套外层
scenario.goal_zh: 确认破损仅在外层，选定内侧缝补片的方法并约好取衣

context_zh: 顾客带来有纪念意义的旧外套咨询修补。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Can you preserve the original fabric? This was my father's coat.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: I'll keep as much as I can. Only the outer layer is torn; the lining is intact.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: Would a patch be very noticeable?

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: I can sew a dark one underneath the tear. The stitching will show a little, but it won't cover the whole pocket.

sentences.speaker: Faye
sentences.text: That's fine. I'd rather see a small repair than replace the fabric.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Then I'll repair it that way. You can collect it on Thursday.
